text:
There are two doctors working here.
A woman and a man.
The woman is an excellent specialist, polite and attentive!
But the doctor is a man...
I've been to him twice.
The first time, he treated my upper front tooth for decay. He said there were no guarantees, the decay could be deep.
I agreed, but the procedure itself was terrible!!! He can't concentrate on his work at all; he'll leave his hand in his mouth with the device and turn away, causing pain. A few comments and the hell was over. Unfortunately, he was right. The decay was deep. Then I went back for more treatment and was treated by a woman.
The second time I saw him...
I had decay in my lower row. He said: "We can 100% cure it, don't even worry." And then I remembered how he works 🤬😩🥵 He damaged my gums with the device, treated the tooth, but acted like he didn't finish.
6-7 months passed. I'm already going to a different clinic.
That tooth hurt all night last night, and I had to have it redone twice. And he said, "No problem, 100%."
I decided to save people from masochism and write about my experience.
UPDATE: Two years have passed, the tooth has turned black, and I had to go back to the woman. This time, she cleaned it and added a new build-up.
But she was so sloppy that I'll have to have the work redone by a different doctor.
And the assistant was incredibly rude! She only had one task, but she used the saliva ejector as if she were stirring sugar in a glass of tea. 🥄

text: I saw Dr. Akhin today for a filling replacement. It's a huge filling in one of my molars and the last dentist who replaced it in the U.S. said I would likely need a crown if it broke again. So, "holding my breath," I went to see Dr. Akhin (hoping it could be filled just one more time) and he was able to do it! Yay!!! Not only that, he also did it entirely without the need to give me a shot. That's a first for me! Anytime in the past I was told that I wouldn't need a shot, there was always that twinge of pain...and then they had to end up giving me the dreaded shot. But not so this time! I'm not sure how he managed it, but I never felt any pain in the tooth the whole time he was drilling. (Great job, Dr. Akhin!) I also really appreciated his "bedside manner" as he is very conscious of the comfort of his patient. He let me take breaks to rest my jaw and neck whenever I needed them. (And I needed several...) It takes a lot to impress me, but this dentist has impressed me more than any dentist I've ever had in the states (USA.) (Yes! By that I mean my entire life!) Not only that! It was also less than a third of the cost of the last time I had the same exact filling done a little over a year ago back home. You just can't beat that! 😀
